result.ocaml:
let threshold_percentage (facility : facility) : decimal =
  if is_qualified_facility_or_energy_storage_technology facility then
    threshold_percentage_subparagraph_b facility
  else
    threshold_percentage_subparagraph_c facility

let has_material_assistance_from_prohibited_foreign_entity (facility : facility) : bool =
  if is_qualified_facility_or_energy_storage_technology facility || produces_eligible_components facility then
    material_assistance_cost_ratio facility <. threshold_percentage facility
  else
    false
result.reason: Threshold percentage picked by facility category (subparagraph B vs C), then cost ratio compared against it.
